description: A Helm chart for installing Kratix (https://kratix.io)

Prometheus exporter for MongoDB (Percona's): server status, replica set, database and collection statistics, as a standalone Deployment pointed at any MongoDB server. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source on Wolfi, nonroot, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Prometheus exporter for MySQL and MariaDB: server status, InnoDB, replication and query statistics, as a standalone Deployment pointed at any MySQL-protocol server. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source on Wolfi, nonroot, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Prometheus node_exporter as a DaemonSet: CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, network and kernel metrics for every node, read from the host's /proc, /sys and root filesystem. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source on Wolfi, nonroot, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Prometheus exporter for PostgreSQL: server, database, replication, lock and statement statistics, as a standalone Deployment pointed at any PostgreSQL server. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source on Wolfi, nonroot, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

Prometheus exporter for Redis and Valkey: memory, clients, keyspace, replication and command statistics, as a standalone Deployment pointed at any Redis-protocol server. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source on Wolfi, nonroot, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
